title: A'ja Wilson scores 36 points as the Aces send the Fever home again with a 94-83 in Game 3 | United States
text:
A’ja Wilson made sure her basketball spoke for itself Thursday night, the four-time WNBA MVP scoring 36 points to lead the defending champion Las Vegas Aces to a 94-83 victory and eliminate the Indiana Fever in the deciding Game 3 of the first round
WNBA The third-seeded Aces, who have won three of the past four titles, moved on to play the winner of the Golden State-Dallas series, which will be decided Friday night in San Francisco.and the Fever, who were seeded sixth.
The teams met in the semifinals a year ago, with the Aces pulling out an overtime victory in the finale of the five-game series. Wilson book ended this series with sensational performances in Games 1 and 3, making her sure verbal confrontation with a Fever fan Tuesday in Indianapolis wouldn't be the enduring memory.
The league did not punish Wilson, who opened the series with 38 points and 16 rebounds, followed up in this game by making 11 of 18 shots and grabbing 10 rebounds. Tensions ran high again Thursday, both teams bringing the physical play expected when each season is on the line in a game that had the intensity of a WNBA Finals.each picked up a technical foul just more than three minutes into Game 3.
The Fever were huddling on the court when Turner worked her way into the group only to be shoved out by Clark. The Aces threatened to run away from Indiana in the third quarter, taking a 67-55 before going cold over the final 4:32 and making just one shot. The Fever twice cut their deficit to two points in the fourth to make Las Vegas sweat out the ending.
